FUNCTION LongestUniqueSubstringLength(str):
    char_map <- EMPTY DICTIONARY
    max_len <- 0
    start <- 0
    
    FOR end FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF str - 1 DO
        char <- str[end]
        IF char IN char_map AND char_map[char] >= start THEN
            start <- char_map[char] + 1
        END IF
        char_map[char] <- end
        max_len <- MAX(max_len, end - start + 1)
    END FOR
    
    RETURN max_len
END FUNCTION
